Laura / Vivek —

I need to start a confidential workflow for an interim manager assignment on the Platform SRE squad. We are aiming to move quickly but this must remain on a need-to-know basis until we have the formal agreement in place. High level: 

- Business reason: current manager (on medical leave) will be out longer than originally expected; team needs an experienced interim to own on-call rotations and the upcoming Q4 incident review.
- Proposed interim: Neha Kapoor (experience with infra and on-call cadence).
- Start date target: 2026-10-20 (flexible by a week).

Attached: interim_assignment_packet.pdf (draft talking points) and a short transition_checklist.xlsx I began. Can PeopleOps prepare the interim assignment paperwork and a suggested comp/bonus guidance? Laura — can you confirm the process (DocuSign vs. offer letter) and any approvals we should track? Vivek — do you approve Neha as the interim for the posted period (until hire completes)?

Requesting confidentiality (no announcement until HR confirms logistics). If we can, Id like a 15-minute sync Wednesday to align comms with the team and the outgoing manager's EM.

Thanks,
Aditya

2) Comp: do you want a one-time interim stipend or temporary title bump? If stipend, suggest we follow precedents (see comp_guidance.docx).
3) Approvals: VP sign-off will be required; who is the approver on record for this team?
4) Communication plan: we will prepare a private DocuSign interim agreement; once signed, we will provide manager script and an all-hands talking point (private).

Ive looped PeopleOps (external) to prepare the DocuSign and to run a payroll impact check. I will upload a redline of your checklist and return a DocuSign envelope by Friday.
